motion.entrance: Use Framer Motion. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion.scroll: Smooth minimal scroll animations with fade/reveal and no layout disruption

accessibility.contrast: Lime background (#D4FF3F) requires dark text (#111111) for accessibility.

images.description: User will upload real profile photo later. Use a solid off-white block with rounded-[2rem] corners as a replaceable placeholder.
Clean, intentional replaceable placeholders. Solid colors (e.g. #EAEAE6) or subtle gradients with no fake images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Recreate the exact intended design as requested: 'Creative, Professional, Playful, Gen Z, Editorial, Modern, Interactive, Personal, and UI/UX designer oriented'.
Use ONLY JavaScript (.js / .jsx), DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Navigation MUST be a rounded/pill-style sticky header containing an 'NV' monogram and links: Beranda, Tentang, Project, Kontak. Include a responsive mobile menu.

The Hero section must feature: 'Halo, saya', 'Mochamad Novanda Vianizar', 'Siswa Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak & UI/UX Enthusiast', a CTA 'Lihat Project Saya', a profile image placeholder area, a badge 'AVAILABLE FOR PKL', and 'OPEN TO NEW IDEAS ↗'.
Ensure 'AVAILABLE FOR PKL' badge does NOT overlap or obscure the user's face (the placeholder image). Use stable positioning.
Use stable responsive layouts. Desktop and mobile must not have overlapping elements, horizontal scrolling/overflow, or fragile positioning.
About Section (Tentang): Focus on authentic student description with an editorial layout.
Skills Section: Include Figma, Canva, CapCut (confident) and Adobe Illustrator, Lightroom (currently learning).
Projects Section: Create cards for 'Sport4All', 'PDAM Smart Management', and 'Sports App Wireflow'. Use clean intentional replaceable placeholders instead of fake images.
Contact Section (Kontak): Include functional email (novandavianizar@gmail.com), LinkedIn, and GitHub links.
Do NOT include blog, testimonials, pricing, services, fake awards, or fake client logos.
Ensure Header/Nav is NOT fully transparent. Use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent background.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb, etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
